name: clone-app-pat-pro
title_zh: 从网址到像素级复刻，全程对话指挥克隆工坊
tagline_zh: 不用看代码，不用拖组件。你报一个网址，它派子代理侦察每个视图、抓计算样式当证据。
tagline_en: Give a URL, get a pixel-perfect clone. Sub-agents recon every view, extract computed styles as ground truth.
desc_en: Clones any web app pixel-for-pixel from a URL. Runs as an IN-CONVERSATION workflow — the live Claude orchestrates Task sub-agents and drives the Claude Chrome extension to recon (every view), extract (computed styles = ground truth), design-spec, build, QA (computed-style assertions), and extend. Guided check-ins, custom features, and an MCP server so an agent can operate the app. Use when cloning
why_zh: 把「计算样式」当唯一事实源，而不是截图或肉眼——所以复刻不靠猜；且整个流程跑在对话里，你能随时叫停。
why_en: Computed styles are the single source of truth, not screenshots or eyeballing — so clones don't rely on guesswork. And it runs.
limit_zh: 只认公开可访问的网页 URL；登录墙、强反爬、或重度 Canvas/WebGL 渲染的站点它拿不到计算样式。
limit_en: Only works on publicly accessible URLs. Login walls, aggressive anti-bot, or heavy Canvas/WebGL sites block style extraction — it will stop and ask.
title_en: Pixel-perfect web app clone from a URL, via chat
